name: dev-flow
description: Plan-first development for agent sessions — investigation series, reviewed plans, verified implementation, a sub-agent dev cycle that carries one change from plan to merge (with eleven role agents, each pinned to one model at one effort: scribe, scout, implementer, implementer-critical, implementer-deep, planner, planner-deep, reviewer, reviewer-light, cross-checker, cross-checker-deep), multi-agent research fan-outs, a research skill family for sourced, verified findings and a curated knowledge base (with the research-lane, research-lane-deep and research-verifier agents, routed by the research skill's own profiles), chain-of-verification fact-checking, and a standing librarian that takes custody of a repo's work: files, dispatches, reviews and lands (soft dependencies: work-items, on which research runs record their dispatches; statusline-hub, whose sensor record gives rate-limit reset times, the quota sense's usage and the research skills' quota; claude-analytics (external), whose sampler sink ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR}/claude-analytics/samples/ the quota sense reads as usage history; context-guard, for checkpoint and rehydration, and its usage-report, which reads item spend; kit-dev, whose update-kit takes retrospective findings; create-repo, which investigate points to when the target repo does not exist yet; sandbox, whose skill investigate and deep-investigation point to for container mounts and sidecar commits; operator-interaction, whose decisions skill librarian-mode and dev-cycle follow to put decisions to the operator, and whose plain-names skill their Reports follow, when it is installed).
